title_sq: Vilë - Për Shitje - Mjull Bathore, Tiranë
description_sq:
Vile Elitare ne shitje prane TEG!
Vile Elitare ne shitje pjese e nje rezidence te re ne Mjull-Bathore!
- Ofrohet per shitje kjo vile e jashtëzakonshme, private, me pishine, në nje prej rezidencave me bashkohore ne kryeqytet, pozicionuar midis kodrave te qeta ne Mjull Bathore.
- Kjo rezidence është një simbol i përsosmërisë arkitekturore dhe qëndrueshmërisë.
Me dizajn mesdhetar, materialet më të mira eco-friendly dhe peizazhe të begata, rezidenca ofron një mjedis ideal për familjet që kërkojnë privatësi dhe ndjenjën e komunitetit.
Shërbimet përfshijnë parking nëntokësor, hapësira rekreative, parqe të gjelbra, korsitë për biçikleta dhe shërbim mirëmbajtjeje 24/7.
- Vila ka nje pozicion ideal ne brendesi te rezidences, me pamje te lire, privatesi dhe nje siperfaqe neto ndertimi prej 553m2, te organizuar ne 3 kate banimi,
*Kati nentoke, i pershtatur ne nje ambient sherbimesh/pushimi, ku e gjithe hapsira eshte shfrytezuar ne detaje, kinema, salle lojrash, palester, tualet, lavanderi, sauna, dhome teknike, etj.
*Kati perdhe, i organizuar ne nje sallon ndenje te bollshem, kuzhina dhe ambienti i ngrenies totalisht i vecuar, nje dhome gjumi, depo, 2 tualete dhe korridoret qe bejne shperndarjen e ambienteve.
*Kati i pare, i ndare ne 4 dhoma gjumi, 2 prej te cilave me garderobe dhe tualet, 3 tualete ne total, korridori shperndares si dhe nje verande e cila aksesohet nga pjesa me e madhe e ambienteve.
- Siperfaqja e truallit eshte 575m2, duke ofruar nje kopesht ne pjesen e prapme te viles, i askesueshem nga te gjithe ambientet, oborrin perpara ne te cilen do te jete pishina, si dhe 2-3 poste parkimi ne hyrjen kryesore te viles.
- Rezidenca perpos arkitektures se vecante, shtrirjes ne siperfaqe cka ofron privatesi dhe komoditet maksimal gjithashtu vecohet per cilesine e larte te punimeve, ku vlejne te vecohen;
- Sistemi i termoizolimit me fasade te ventiluar, cilesia me e larte,
- Sistemi i kondicionimit qendror, multislplit,
- Shtrim me pllake/parket te prodhuar dhe importuar nga Spanja,
- Vetrata alumin termik, tripleks, etj.
- Rezidenca ofron gjithashtu mundesine e furnizimit me uje 24h, nepemjet depove te krijuar enkas per banoret e rezidences.
Mundesi financimi nga banka deri ne 70% te vleres.
Per me shume informacion kontaktoni!.
title_en: Villa - For Sale - Mjull Bathore, Tirana
description_en: Elite villas for sale near TEG! Elite villa for sale, part of a new residence in Mjull-Bathore! - Offered for sale is this exceptional, private villa with swimming pool, in one of the most contemporary residences in the capital, positioned among the quiet hills in Mjull Bathore. - This residence is a symbol of architectural excellence and durability. With Mediterranean design, the best eco-friendly materials and lush landscaping, the residence offers an ideal setting for families looking for privacy and a sense of community. Services include underground parking, recreational spaces, green parks, bike lanes and 24/7 maintenance service. - The villa has an ideal position inside the residence, with a free view, privacy and a net construction area of ​​553m2, organized in 3 residential floors, *Ground floor, adapted to a service/rest environment, where the entire space is used in detail, cinema, game room, gym, toilet, laundry, sauna, technical room, etc. *Ground floor, organized in a spacious living room, kitchen and dining area completely separate, a bedroom, storage room, 2 toilets and the corridors that distribute the premises. *The first floor, divided into 4 bedrooms, 2 of which have wardrobes and toilets, 3 toilets in total, distribution corridor and a veranda which is accessed from most of the premises. - The surface of the land is 575m2, offering a garden at the back of the villa, accessible from all the premises, the front yard where the swimming pool will be, as well as 2-3 parking spaces at the main entrance of the villa. - Apart from the special architecture, the extension on the surface which offers maximum privacy and comfort, the residence is also distinguished for the high quality of the works, where they are worth distinguishing; - Thermal insulation system with ventilated facades, the highest quality, - Central air conditioning system, multisplit, - Flooring with tiles/parquets produced and imported from Spain, - Thermal aluminum windows, triplex, etc. - The residence also offers the possibility of 24h water supply, as well as storage tanks created especially for the residents of the residence. Possibility of financing from the bank up to 70% of the value. For more information, contact!
